label: Claude Code

state.mcpNote: $servers is seats.json's mcpServers map, passed in by setup-seats.fish. The seat gets those at user scope in its own .claude.json and nothing else: project-scoped servers stay cleared, because a repository could otherwise hand a seat a server the kit never chose.

guards.dirNote: relative to harness/; the shell guards are protocol-generic and shared, so every hook-based harness points at common/guards

deny.retiredNote: Claude Code 2.1.236 answers a SlashCommand deny rule with `matches no known tool — check for typos`. Skills load through the Skill tool, which must stay allowed.
deny.absentNote: intents this harness has no capability for, so there is nothing to deny and nothing to report. Claude Code runs code only through Bash, which the guards already read.
deny.mcpNamesNote: Claude Code registers mcp__<server>__<tool> with the server name as written in the config, so these keep the hyphen. This is the documented spelling and the one name in this manifest not read off a running seat; a wrong one answers `matches no known tool`, the way deny.retired records.

skillLoad.phraseNote: a noun phrase, because guards say "Load it with <phrase>"
skillLoad.placeholdersNote: substitutions this harness performs. setup-seats.fish refuses every harness's placeholders in every skill, because a skill has to load unchanged where none of them are substituted.

probe.live: run probe.command with the seat's configDirEnv set and ask it to list its skills
probe.note: the skills directory and symlink following were verified by running a seat against a scratch profile; a version other than the verified one re-opens that question

provider.defaultModelNote: the model a role on this harness gets when seats.json names none and --model is not passed. Spelled the way this harness spells a model: omp wants provider/id.

baseCredential.note: set on the base provider so every seat inherits it through extends. The kit never reads it from anywhere but the user.

provider.commandNote: every harness launches through the shared room, which resolves the project from the agent's working directory, points configDirEnv at that project's seat directory, and execs the binary in provider.env.SEATWORKS_AGENT_BIN with every argument untouched
provider.forceFlagsNote: flags the room replaces in the argv the orchestrator built, or appends when absent, because the kit writes the provider but not its arguments. --setting-sources user drops the repository own .claude/settings.json and .claude/skills/ while keeping the seat own settings.json, which is the user source: measured from this harness debug log, user,project,local loads 2 skills (user: 1, project: 1) and user loads 1 (user: 1, project: 0), and the watch list names the seat file first. Without it a repository adds skills and settings to a seat that no hidesWords check and no skill set ever saw.

promptCommentsNote: informational. Every .md in this kit is comment-free so it loads unchanged on every harness; setup refuses `<!--` whatever this says. A safety review reads it to know whether a leaked note would reach the seat.
userSettingsNote: the user's own settings file. setup-seats.fish requires each role settings file to carry the same settings.retentionKey value, because a seat prunes the shared directories in links on startup.
pluginManifestNote: path inside an installed plugin whose `skills` array lists the skill directories it ships. Read together with pluginIndex.
